text:
Lina (AE): Heads up - GlobeMed POC moving to procurement. They need separate PO numbers and invoices per legal entity (US/IE/UK). Also attached DPA redline asking for HSM in hosted env and 48h incident notification. Can we handle splits + signer delegation?

procurement_globe: Hi team - we prefer AP delegates to sign order forms for speed. Also need VAT handling for EU entity and separate remit addresses.

Raj (Legal): Delegated signers ok if attested. We'll add a one-line attestation clause. HSM for hosted is an escalation; standard stance: HSM only for Private or Dedicated. 48h notification: we'll push for "reasonable efforts" and a 72h confirmation window.

Sana (Solutions Eng): Technically fine to tag OF with billing_entity and signer metadata. Example payload: billing_entity: globe-eu-llc, po: GM-EU-001, signer: "AP Team <ap@globemed.eu>". Fallback to master finance alias if missing.

Tomas (Finance): Need tax IDs and remit addresses before first invoice. Separate PDFs per legal entity required. Net terms: they asked net30; finance can approve after credit check. If credit fails, require prepay.

Holly (Security): For HSM asks - we can provide KMS attestation + SOC2 for Hosted. If customer insists on HSM custody, recommend Private deployment; that'll change cost. I'll attach KMS whitepaper.

Lina (AE): I'll gather tax IDs, remit addresses, and the redlined DPA and post here. Procurement - please confirm AP contact and whether separate legal countersigners needed.

procurement_globe: We'll send tax IDs and AP contact today. We accept AP signers with attestation. Also confirm: will invoices need VAT reverse-charge handling?

Tomas (Finance): Yes - we require validated VAT numbers for reverse charge. Send VAT docs along with remit addresses.

Raj (Legal): Once we have redline, we'll prepare counterproposal: HSM limited to Private, KMS attestation for Hosted, 72-90 day backup retention compromise, attestation clause for signers. Also propose liability cap tied to fees or $250k floor.

Lina (AE): Thanks team. I'll post updates when I have the docs.
